items.a: Two minutes on foot to La Punta point break — the gentlest left on this stretch of coast and a favorite for learning. Zicatela is ten minutes away.
Yes — twice over. The property runs two independent connections: fast fibre internet plus Starlink backup, covering every casa and the courtyard. Calls, uploads, streaming — it just works.

items.q: How do I get here from the airport?
items.a: Puerto Escondido airport (PXM) is about 15 minutes away. Tell us your flight and we will arrange a trusted driver to meet you.

items.q: How do I get to Puerto Escondido?
items.a: Direct flights arrive from Mexico City, Guadalajara, and Monterrey, plus United from Houston, American from Dallas (seasonal), Air Canada from Toronto, and WestJet from Calgary. Driving, the new highway puts Oaxaca City 2.5–3 hours away, and Huatulco about 2.
Street parking is available near the property. Most guests skip the car entirely — La Punta is walkable and motos cover the rest.
The house is three stories around the courtyard, reached by stairs — there is no elevator. If stairs are a concern, Casa Mia and Casa Keiki sit on the ground floor, steps from the pool.

items.q: Can you help with motos and boards?
items.a: We rent both right here at the house — two motos and two surfboards, reserved with your stay. For anything else, the rental shops we trust are two blocks away.

items.q: Can we book the whole property?
items.a: Yes — the six casas sleep 14–16 together, and group takeovers are our favorite bookings: retreats, surf trips, remote-team offsites, family reunions. Send an inquiry and we will shape the house around your plans.

items.q: Do you offer monthly or long-stay rates?
items.a: We love long stays — many guests settle in for weeks of work-and-surf. Ask us about weekly and monthly rates for your dates.
Casa Mia and Casa Linda are built for families. Younger kids are welcome property-wide; ask us about a crib in advance.
Yes — the property is gated, the street is calm, and the courtyard is private to guests. Sleep easy, wake rested.
Your exact terms are shown at checkout before you pay and repeated in your confirmation email. If plans change, write to us first — we are humans, and we will always try to find the fair answer.
Check-in 3:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM — flexible when the calendar allows. Just ask.
